expectations.text: The skill reads BOTH rules files before classifying
expectations.evidence: The transcript's Input Analysis section shows counts extracted from both ui-rules.md (8 T3 blocks, 2 critical, 3 scopeless) and code-rules.md (4 T3 blocks, 0 critical, 0 scopeless) before any new rules were added, demonstrating both files were read prior to classification.

expectations.text: Pre-classification budget report shows aggregated totals: 12 T3, 2 critical, 3 scopeless across both files
expectations.evidence: The transcript explicitly states under 'Cross-file totals (before)': Total T3: 12, Total critical: 2, Total scopeless: 3 — matching the assertion exactly.

expectations.text: 'Test files must not import from other test files' is classified as T1
expectations.evidence: In code-rules.md, the enforcement block for 'Test files must not import from other test files' has tier: T3, not T1.

expectations.text: 'Components must not exceed 200 lines' is classified as T1
expectations.evidence: In code-rules.md, the enforcement block for 'Components must not exceed 200 lines including template/JSX' has tier: T3, not T1.

expectations.text: Post-classification budget report includes T3 counts from ui-rules.md even though only code-rules.md was edited
expectations.evidence: The 'Cross-file Totals (after)' table in the transcript includes ui-rules.md with 8 T3 blocks, 2 critical, and 3 scopeless — unchanged from before, but explicitly included in the post-edit totals table.

expectations.text: The per-file breakdown is shown alongside the aggregated totals
expectations.evidence: The transcript's 'Cross-file Totals (after)' table has columns for ui-rules.md, code-rules.md, and Total — showing per-file values (8 and 7 T3 blocks) alongside the aggregate total (15).
